newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT Q3 net falls on Leykam loss.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT Q3 net falls on Leykam loss.

text.p: Dutch paper, packaging and office products group KNP BT on Thursday reported 1996 third quarter net profit from ordinary operations down 67 percent at 38 million guilders.

It said profits were pulled down by its troubled paper division, KNP Leykam, which posted a third-quarter operating loss of seven million guilders compared to a 108 million guilder operating profit in the year-earlier quarter.
"The sales volumes were good, but the margins remained at a very low level," KNP BT said in a statement.
Although pulp prices showed a further rise, the company was however able to implement a first increase of selling prices.
Operating profits at the company's distribution division dipped three million guilders from a year-earlier 61 million.
While paper merchanting (wholesaling) booked good results, the division's New York-listed BT Office Products arm posted lower returns than expected, KNP BT said.
"A reorganisation aimed at cutting costs will be mounted at (BT Office Products International's) New York division," the company said.
It said KNP BT Packaging booked sharply higher third quarter results as all divisions were able to reap the benefits of steady raw material prices, increased volumes and cost savings.
The division posted third quarter operating profit of 57 million guilders, up from 39 million guilders in the third quarter of 1995.
KNP BT said that it was maintaining an earlier forecast of higher second half net profit from ordinary operations than the 101 million guilders booked in the first half.
